title: Cloud Resources Inventory Info event (cloud-posture inventory for misconfiguration triage)
summary:
OCSF Cloud Resources Inventory Info events describing the cloud resources a posture finding refers to. cloud_misconfiguration reads them to resolve the flagged resource to its owner, exposure and configuration state before deciding whether a finding is a real exposure or an accepted pattern. Consumed only.

Note the stable_id keeps the shorter `cloud_resource_inventory` form the asserting playbook already uses, while `ocsf.class_name` carries the exact upstream name — the stable_id is a join key and renaming it would break the refs it exists to resolve.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 Discovery category — Cloud Resources Inventory Info class (uid 5023)
